comments.body: Please cite `upstream/bzlib.c` for the decompressor's combined-CRC calculation and comparison (`BZ2_bzDecompress`, lines 825–847). `upstream/decompress.c` lines 601–609 only read the stored trailer CRC, so the current citation attributes the combination to the wrong file. `bzlib.c` lines 217–221 and 263–267 also support the original-byte block CRC claim at line 35; please cite those update sites.

last.summary: The CRC definitions and examples match the vendored bzip2, and verification passes. Please correct the source attribution for decompression and the original-byte block CRC claim.
